title: Array patterns — flatten, group, deduplicate
solution:
const nested = [[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]]
const flat = nested.flat()
console.log(flat)
const arr = [1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4]
const unique = [...new Set(arr)]
console.log(unique)
const nums = [10, 5, 8, 1, 7]
nums.sort((a, b) => b - a)
console.log(nums)
const numbers = [1, 3, 5, 8, 9, 10]
const firstEven = numbers.find(n => n % 2 === 0)
console.log(firstEven)
hints: flat() ek level flatten karta hai
Set sirf unique values rakhta hai
sort((a,b) => b-a) se descending sort hota hai
